note: Proposed plan for discussion at kickoff. Dates are targets, not commitments, until the steering group approves them.

phases.name: Mobilize and charter
phases.goal: Agree scope, team, governance and budget envelope. Read the GlobalWave contract.
deliverables: Project charter approved
Core team named with time commitments
GlobalWave contract terms summarized (notice, renewal, data return, exit fees)
Budget envelope for evaluation and implementation

phases.name: Current state and requirements
phases.goal: Document how commercial loans flow today and what the new system must do.
deliverables: Current-state process maps (RM, credit, loan ops, doc prep, boarding)
Pain-point survey of RMs, PMs, analysts and loan ops
Prioritized requirements (must / should / could)
Integration inventory: COCC, LaserPro, Identifi, Abrigo
Data inventory and conversion needs from GlobalWave

phases.name: Market scan and RFP
phases.goal: Build a verified vendor field and run a fair, scripted evaluation.
deliverables: Long list and RFI (including the incumbent)
Weighted scoring model agreed before demos
RFP issued to 3-5 vendors
Scripted demos using the bank's own sample deals
Reference calls with banks of similar size on COCC

phases.name: Selection, due diligence and contract
phases.goal: Pick a vendor, complete third-party risk review, and sign.
deliverables: Selection recommendation to steering group and board
Third-party risk management due diligence (SOC reports, financials, BCP)
Negotiated contract with implementation SOW and exit terms
Short-term GlobalWave extension option secured as insurance

phases.name: Implementation and integration
phases.goal: Configure workflows, build integrations, and convert data.
deliverables: Configured workflows, templates and approval authorities
Integrations to COCC, LaserPro, Identifi and Abrigo risk rating
Data conversion mock runs
Reports and covenant/tickler setup

phases.name: Testing, training and cutover
phases.goal: Prove it works on real deals and get every user ready.
deliverables: System and integration testing
User acceptance testing with RMs, credit and loan ops
Role-based training and super-users
Cutover plan and go/no-go

phases.name: Stabilize and decommission GlobalWave
phases.goal: Support users after go-live and retire the old system cleanly.
deliverables: Hypercare support (60-90 days)
Final data extract and archive from GlobalWave
Records-retention and exam-readiness check
GlobalWave access ended before 2029-03-01

buffer.label: Buffer: about 7 months between target go-live and contract end

criticalPathNotes: Contract signature by end of August 2027 leaves 8 months to implement and 4 months to test and train before an August 2028 go-live.

Implementation time varies widely. The source claimed 12-18 months for nCino; nCino's own filings cite under 6 months on average for community banks. Ask every vendor for actual timelines at banks our size with our integrations, and check with references. Anything over 11 months from an August 2027 signature eats into the buffer.
Avoid a go-live at quarter-end or year-end. An August 2028 target stays clear of both.
The GlobalWave contract may require notice of non-renewal months before it ends. That date could land in 2028 and must be found in the contract during Phase 0.
